# StickStage

> StickStage is an open-source (MIT) stick figure video generator. You write a premise and the
> lines; it renders a captioned, lip-synced 9:16 comedy short (1080×1920 MP4) for YouTube Shorts,
> TikTok or Reels. It runs offline with no account or API key: Kokoro voices on the CPU, Rhubarb
> lip sync, and frame-by-frame rendering with Remotion. A skit is one JSON file.

Quickstart: `pnpm install && pnpm bootstrap && pnpm demo` (Node 22+, pnpm). Make your own with
`pnpm try "my cat ignores me"`. Coding agents must follow AGENTS.md (frame-pure rendering,
everything is data, no network at render time). Repository: https://github.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/README.md): what it is, quickstart, gallery, FAQ, licences

- [What you are making](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/docs/what-you-are-making.md): the finished short, for a newcomer
- [Your first video](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/docs/your-first-video.md): top to bottom, sample short then your own
- [Set up the machine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/docs/set-up.md): install, the service, the failures you will see
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/AGENTS.md): rules and commands for coding agents

## Making videos

- [Writing the joke](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/docs/writing-the-joke.md): from a topic or your own lines to a premise
- [The skit file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/docs/skits.md): every field of `skit.json`
- [People, rooms, and shapes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/docs/cast-rooms-and-shapes.md): exact ids for characters, sets and props
- [Watch it and change it](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/docs/watch-and-change.md): reviewing and fixing a render
- [The files you hand over](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/docs/files-you-hand-over.md): MP4, captions and post files
- [Making a science short](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/docs/science-channel.md): myth-flip explainers with sourced claims
- [Story episodes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/docs/stories.md): narrated 16:9 stories with the shape cast
- [Figures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/docs/figures.md): diagrams, equations and images timed to the words

## Claude Code skills

- [topic-to-video](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/skills/topic-to-video/SKILL.md): a topic to a ~30 s skit, end to end
- [skit-director](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/skills/skit-director/SKILL.md): stages a premise you wrote
- [science-short](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/skills/science-short/SKILL.md): a myth-flip science short
- [toon-character](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/skills/toon-character/SKILL.md): add or change a toon character
- [story-episode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tamtree-ai/stick-stage/main/skills/story-episode/SKILL.md): an idea to a narrated 16:9 story
